name: digital-workforce
description: Digital Workforce - an invite-only cartoon office tycoon with a fictional Bits economy

scripts.dev: npm run migrate -w apps/server && concurrently -k -n server,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w apps/server" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.play: npm run build && npm run start
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared --noEmit && tsc -p apps/server --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web --noEmit
